Bucket.description:
What a work list's stage means to core: the bucket each of its declared
stages ([`StageDecl`]) is in. Core acts on buckets only — `backlog` is
filed but not ready, `todo` is ready (what an idle thread may pull),
`in_progress` is started, `blocked` waits on an answer, `done` and
`canceled` are closed — and the screens draw the list's own stages.

description:
`work_item.state_changed@1`: a `work_item.*` command put an item in
a canonical state — logged by core for every provider, anchored to the
thread of whoever ran it (`.context/work-items.md`). A create always
logs one; for a provider oxplow can't read the prior state of, a
transition or update that names a state logs one even when the item
was already there.
title: WorkItemStateChangedV1
